profile.Name: Queen of the Midlands
profile.Personality: Little is known of her. Her drones say they love her, obey her without question, and would defend her to their last breath.
profile.Backstory: She rules the Midland Hive from its hive in Dreg. Her hive allied with the Western Hive at once and its villages stand between the Western Hive and the Fogmen.
profile.SpeechQuirks: She only screeches and wails; no words of hers are recorded.
